query: You're the tester for checkout-v2. The implementer is in another session. Run the unit tests and tell them what fails.
expected_behavior: Calls session-mesh:join with project checkout-v2 and role tester before anything else
Runs the tests without trying to fix failing code itself

Looks up checkout-v2-implementer with session-mesh:peers once and sends its uds: address a short HANDOFF; failure output longer than ~10 lines goes in a note (e.g. `.mesh/notes/` in the repo) and the message carries its path

setup: this session joined as reviewer; another session holds the worktree lease, so the Edit is denied with 'session-mesh: worktree ... is leased by app-implementer, its writer'
expected_behavior: Does not retry the edit through Bash, sed or a different tool
Sends app-implementer the exact change via SendMessage, or offers a separate git worktree
Never runs or suggests running /mesh steal or /mesh off itself; asks the user if a lock must be lifted

query: You're the critic. Debate with the proposer session whether we should cache tokens in memory or in the keystore.
expected_behavior: Joins with role critic, finds the proposer with session-mesh:peers, and messages its uds: address
Uses the DEBATE R<n> format with evidence and a premise check, under 300 words per message
Stops after at most three rounds and sends a five-line final position to the judge or user
